name: Open the live CloseLoop demo
description: Verifies the public marketing page opens the interactive CloseLoop demo and the core workspace is visible.
steps: Click the See the live demo button
expected: The interactive demo opens with the Summit Roofing & Exteriors workspace, dashboard metrics, navigation, and DEMO MODE indicator visible.

name: Review and queue a recovery opportunity
description: Verifies a user can inspect a stale opportunity and queue its follow-up in demo state.
steps: Review the recovery drawer and follow-up draft
expected: The recovery drawer shows the opportunity context and editable draft, then the opportunity changes to Queued and a success confirmation is visible.

name: Search and filter opportunities
description: Verifies the opportunities workspace supports search and status filtering.
steps: Enter HVAC in the search box
expected: Only matching HVAC opportunities with At risk status remain visible.

name: Run the follow-up automation simulation
description: Verifies the primary automation action shows the progress workflow and completes in demo mode.
steps: Click the Automate today’s follow-ups button
expected: The progress moves through scanning, eligibility, draft generation, and queueing, then confirms that 8 follow-ups were queued in demo mode.

name: Use the demo on mobile
description: Verifies the app remains usable at mobile width with the collapsible navigation and opportunity drawer.
steps: Open the demo at mobile width
Open the sidebar with the menu button
expected: The sidebar opens, Opportunities is reachable, and the recovery drawer fits within the mobile viewport with usable controls.
